  (φ : Ov.Spec K V) (P : Finset V) (t : Ov.Ten K V),
  (∀ q ∉ P, Subsingleton (t.ι q)) →
    ∀ {J : ℕ} [inst_4 : NeZero J] (T : Fin J → Ov.Ten K V),
      t.SumRestr T → φ.F t ≤ ↑J ^ Nc.Price.hexp φ Subtype.val * Finset.univ.sup' ⋯ fun j => φ.F (T j)
Paper.lem_convex : ∀ (K : Type) [inst : Field K] {n : ℕ} (V : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) {I : Type}
  [inst_1 : Fintype I] [inst_2 : DecidableEq I] {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∃ δ > 0,
      ∀ (φ : Ov.Spec K ↥V) (c : ℝ),
        0 ≤ c →
          (∀ (x y : ↥V), |c * φ.e x y - dist x y| < δ) →
            ∀ (a b m : I → ↥V),
              (∀ (i : I), ↑(m i) = midpoint ℝ ↑(a i) ↑(b i)) →
                c * Nc.Price.hexp φ m ≤ 1 / 2 * (c * Nc.Price.hexp φ a) + 1 / 2 * (c * Nc.Price.hexp φ b) + ε
@Paper.prop_cube : ∀ {K : Type} [inst : Field K],
  Paper.Flat K →
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (V P : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))) (hPV : P ⊆ V),
      P.Nonempty →
        (∀ x ∈ P, ∃ j b, x = (if b = true then 1 / 2 else -(1 / 2)) • EuclideanSpace.single j 1) →
          ∀ {ε : ℝ},
            0 < ε →
              ∃ φ c,
                0 ≤ c ∧ (∀ (x y : ↥V), |c * φ.e x y - dist x y| < ε) ∧ (c * Nc.Price.hexp φ fun x => ⟨↑x, ⋯⟩) ≤ √↑k + ε
@Paper.prop_flat_rate_printed : ∀ {K : Type} [inst : Field K],

Paper.flat_rate_complete : ∀ (κ : ℕ),

Paper.lem_lowdeg : ∃ c,
  ∀ (R : Type) [inst : CommRing R] (M m N d S : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin N × Option Bool) R),
    Nc.Computes p S →
      S ≤ 2 ^ M →
        N ≤ 2 ^ m →
          ∃ K D,
            K.nds ≤ 2 ^ (3 * M + 1) + 2 ^ (M + m + 3) + 3 ∧
              K.ht ≤ 3 * M + m + 4 ∧
                D.size ≤ c * (M + m + 1) + 2 * (d + 1) ∧
                  ∀ (A : Type) [inst_1 : CommRing A] [inst_2 : Algebra A R] (θ : List Bool → A) (z : NS1.Tree),
                    z.size < N →
                      NS1.Hl θ (NS1.Fm.ofTree D) z ∧
                        (∀ r ∈ NS1.evl θ (NS1.Fm.ofTree D) z,
                            r.cost ≤ (d + 1) * (800 * (M + m) + 4000) + (z.size + 2) * (40 * m + 60) + 10 * m + 100 ∧
                              ∀ q ∈ r.bill, NS1.KT.InB 1 K q) ∧
                          NS1.val K.lk (NS1.evl θ (NS1.Fm.ofTree D) z) =
                            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1),
                              (MvPolynomial.eval (NS1.codeB R N (NS1.tbits z)))
                                ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent i) p)
@Paper.lem_circuit_phi : ∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] {Γ S Q : Type} [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [inst_2 : DecidableEq Γ]
  [inst_3 : Fintype S] [inst_4 : DecidableEq S] [inst_5 : Fintype Q] [inst_6 : DecidableEq Q]
  (mu : Nc.Letter S Unit Γ → Matrix Q Q F) (i e : Q) (t N : ℕ),
  ∃ V K x x_1 x_2 x_3 lits wt,
    (∀ (κ : K), lits κ ≠ []) ∧
      (∀ (b : V), ∃ κ, ∃ l ∈ lits κ, l.1 = b) ∧
        (∀ (κ : K), (∃ i, wt κ = MvPolynomial.X i) ∨ ∃ a, wt κ = MvPolynomial.C a) ∧
          ∑ κ, (lits κ).length ≤ 1600 * (t + N + Fintype.card Q + Fintype.card S + Fintype.card Γ + 2) ^ 9 ∧
            (Paper.clauseSum lits wt).totalDegree ≤ N ∧
              ∀ (u : List Γ),
                u.length + 1 ≤ N →
                  (MvPolynomial.eval fun b => if Nc.code1 N u b = true then 1 else 0) (Paper.clauseSum lits wt) =
                    Nc.runVal mu i e t fun x => u

Paper.prop_tower : ∀ (h : ℕ) [inst : NeZero h] (h3 : 3 ≤ h),
  ∃ C,
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      Fintype.card (Nc.Tower.XX h n 0) = Nat.card (Nc.Tower.G h n) ∧
        (∀ j < Nc.Tower.JJ h n,
            (∀ (d : Nc.Tower.XX h n (j + 1)), {c | Nc.Tower.pr c = d}.card = 2 ^ Nc.Tower.ee h) ∧
              ∀ (g : Nc.Tower.G h n) (c : Nc.Tower.XX h n j), Nc.Tower.pr (g • c) = g • Nc.Tower.pr c) ∧
          (∀ (i : Fin h),
              Function.Injective ⇑(Nc.Tower.th i) ∧
                (∀ (l : Fin (h - 1)), (Nc.Tower.th i) (Nc.Tower.x h l) = Nc.Tower.gen ⋯ (Nc.Tower.sh i l)) ∧
                  (∀ (j : ℕ) (u : ↥(Nc.Tower.U h)) (c : Nc.Tower.XX h n j), (Nc.Tower.th i) u • c = c → u = 1) ∧
                    (∀ (j : ℕ) (c : Nc.Tower.XX h n j) (u : ↥(Nc.Tower.U h)),
                        (Nc.Tower.th i) u • c ≠ Nc.Tower.gen ⋯ i • c) ∧
                      ∀ (j : ℕ) (c : Nc.Tower.XX h n j) (u : ↥(Nc.Tower.U h)),
                        Nc.Tower.pr ((Nc.Tower.th i) u • c) = (Nc.Tower.th i) u • Nc.Tower.pr c) ∧
            (∀ (i : Fin h),
                (∀ (k : Fin h), k ≠ i → ∃ l, Nc.Tower.sh i l = k) ∧
                  (∀ (H : Subgroup (Nc.Tower.G h n)),
                      (∀ (k : Fin h), k ≠ i → Nc.Tower.gen ⋯ k ∈ H) → ∀ (u : ↥(Nc.Tower.U h)), (Nc.Tower.th i) u ∈ H) ∧
                    ∀ j < Nc.Tower.JJ h n,
                      ∀ (v : Nc.Tower.VV h n (j + 1) i), {w | Nc.Tower.prV w = v}.card = 2 ^ Nc.Tower.ee h) ∧
              Fintype.card (Nc.Tower.XX h n (Nc.Tower.JJ h n)) < Nat.card (Nc.Tower.SL2 h) * 2 ^ Nc.Tower.ee h ∧
                Nat.card (Nc.Tower.G h (n + 1)) = Nat.card (Nc.Tower.G h n) * 2 ^ (h ^ 2 - 1) ∧
                  ∀ (g : Nc.Tower.G h n), ∃ l, l.length ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ 7 ∧ (List.map (Nc.Tower.gen ⋯) l).prod = g
